name: pr-review-fixes-checksum
details: Fix critical issues identified in comprehensive PR review before merging feature/checksum-concurrency-detection to dev. Review session 781d7a06 identified 7 CRITICAL issues that must be fixed before merge, plus 5 important improvements. This plan covers Phase 1 (critical - required) and Phase 2 (important - recommended).

tasks.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
tasks.details: 7 critical issues that MUST be fixed before merge. Estimated 2.5-3 hours total.

sub_tasks.name: Issue 1: Fix silent mkdir failure
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/locking.ts:219-223
Problem: Empty catch block swallows ALL mkdir errors (EACCES, EROFS, ENOSPC, etc.)
Solution: Catch only EEXIST specifically, throw all other errors with context
Time: 10 minutes
Verification: Manual test with permission denied scenario

sub_tasks.name: Issue 2: Add concurrent lock contention test
sub_tasks.details:
Location: test/integration/concurrent-checksum.test.ts
Problem: Core feature (Layer 2 - concurrent modification during lock wait) not tested. Lines 359-361 in locking.ts UNCOVERED
Solution: Add test with actual lock contention using setTimeout() to create race
Time: 45 minutes
Verification: Coverage report shows lines 359-361 covered, test passes

sub_tasks.name: Issue 3: Add cache-after-failure tests
sub_tasks.details:
Location: test/memory-operations.test.ts
Problem: No tests verify checksum cache isn't corrupted when operations fail
Solution: Add 3 tests - str_replace fails, insert fails, delete fails
Time: 30 minutes
Verification: All 3 tests pass without code changes (validates current implementation)

sub_tasks.name: Issue 4: Fix directory deletion memory leak
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/operations.ts:554-561 + src/memory/checksums.ts
Problem: Deleting directory only clears cache for directory, not children - memory leak
Solution: Add getAllCachedEntries() export, implement clearCachedChecksumsRecursive() helper, use in delete operation
Time: 30 minutes
Verification: New test passes showing child cache entries cleared

sub_tasks.name: Issue 5: Correct memory calculation
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/checksums.ts:125-130
Problem: Memory estimate 3-4x too low (64 chars = 128 bytes not 32, total ~270 bytes not 102)
Solution: Fix calculation and add clear disclaimer about approximation
Time: 15 minutes
Verification: Visual inspection of corrected comment

sub_tasks.name: Issue 6: Fix path validation comment
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/formatting.ts:30
Problem: Comment says start line can be -1 but code rejects it (only end line accepts -1)
Solution: Change comment to 'must be >= 1'
Time: 2 minutes
Verification: Visual inspection

sub_tasks.name: Issue 7: Fix case sensitivity comment
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/checksums.ts:60-61
Problem: Comment claims path.resolve() handles case sensitivity - factually wrong
Solution: Correct comment to explain case handling depends on filesystem
Time: 2 minutes
Verification: Visual inspection

tasks.name: Phase 2: Important Improvements
tasks.details: 5 quality improvements that should be fixed but aren't merge blockers. Estimated 1-2 hours total.

sub_tasks.name: Issue 8: Improve file deletion error message
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/locking.ts:354
Problem: Raw ENOENT error when file deleted during lock wait - confusing
Solution: Wrap post-lock readFile in try-catch with context-specific error messages
Time: 15 minutes

sub_tasks.name: Issue 9: Fix || vs ?? bug
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/operations.ts:469
Problem: Uses || instead of ?? for parameter fallback (empty string bug)
Solution: Change to ?? for consistency with lines 320-321
Time: 2 minutes

sub_tasks.name: Issue 10: Remove stale temporal marker
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/locking.ts:379
Problem: 'NEW FUNCTION' comment will age poorly
Solution: Replace with descriptive comment about purpose
Time: 2 minutes

sub_tasks.name: Issue 11: Fix performance claims
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/checksums.ts:38-41
Problem: Unvalidated specific performance numbers that will become stale
Solution: Soften claims to 'sub-millisecond' and 'typical' ranges
Time: 5 minutes

sub_tasks.name: Issue 12: Add double-read TODO
sub_tasks.details:
Location: src/memory/operations.ts:170-176
Problem: File read twice (view + checksum) without explanation
Solution: Add TODO comment explaining why and potential optimization
Time: 3 minutes

tasks.name: Testing & Verification
tasks.details: Run full test suite and verify all fixes are working correctly

sub_tasks.name: Run full test suite
sub_tasks.details:
Command: npm test
Expected: 165+ tests passing (162 existing + 3 new from Issue #3 + 1 from Issue #4 + 1 from Issue #2)

sub_tasks.name: Verify coverage maintained
sub_tasks.details:
Command: npm run test:coverage
Expected: ≥93% coverage (should increase to ~94%)
Critical: Lines 359-361 in locking.ts must be covered

sub_tasks.name: Run linting
sub_tasks.details:
Command: npm run lint
Expected: No errors

sub_tasks.name: Type check
sub_tasks.details:
Command: npm run build
Expected: Successful compilation

sub_tasks.name: Update short-term memory
sub_tasks.details: Update session handoff with completion status and what was fixed

sub_tasks.name: Create commit
sub_tasks.details:
Commit message format:
'fix: address critical PR review findings

- Fix empty catch block in mkdir (silent failure)
- Add concurrent lock contention test
- Add cache-after-failure tests
- Fix directory deletion cache leak
- Correct memory calculation (was 3-4x too low)
- Fix misleading comments (path validation, case sensitivity)
- Improve error messages and code consistency'
